name: get_doctor
description: Check agent setup and diagnostics, including Docker, persistent storage, DNS, TLS, and proxy health. Read-only; does not change server settings.

name: list_projects
description: List all projects and their environments known to the Relay agent.

name: list_deploys
description: List recent deploys. Filter by app, env, and/or branch. Returns build numbers, statuses, deployed_by, commit messages, and timestamps.

name: get_deploy
description: Get a single deploy record by ID including status, logs reference, image tag, and commit info.

name: get_deploy_logs
description: Fetch the stored build and deploy logs for a given deploy ID.

name: cancel_deploy
description: Cancel an in-progress deploy by ID.

name: rollback
description: Roll back the most recent deploy to the previous image for an app/env/branch.

name: start_app
description: Start a stopped app container without triggering a new build.

name: stop_app
description: Stop a running app container.

name: restart_app
description: Restart a running app container in place without a new build.

name: delete_lane
description: Delete a lane and remove its container, workspace, and state from the agent.

name: get_app_config
description: Get the current lane configuration for an app including access_policy, public_host, engine, host_port, service_port, and rollout settings.

name: set_app_config
description: Update lane configuration for an app. Only supply the fields you want to change.

name: list_secrets
description: List secret key names (not values) for an app/env/branch.

name: add_secret
description: Add or update a secret value for an app/env/branch. The value is encrypted at rest if RELAY_SECRET_KEY is configured on the agent.

name: remove_secret
description: Delete a secret by key for an app/env/branch.

name: list_promotions
description: List promotion requests. Shows source/target lane, image, approval state, and post-promote health status.

name: approve_promotion
description: Approve a queued promotion request by ID. Requires owner role.

name: list_users
description: List all user accounts with their roles. Requires owner role.

name: get_audit_log
description: Fetch recent audit log entries showing actor, action, target, and timestamp. Requires owner role.

name: get_server_config
description: Get server-level config: base_domain, dashboard_host, ACME settings, and active theme. Requires owner role.

name: set_server_config
description: Update server-level config. Supply only the fields to change. Requires owner role.

name: list_buildpack_plugins
description: List installed buildpack plugins on the agent.

name: remove_buildpack_plugin
description: Remove an installed buildpack plugin by name. Requires RELAY_ENABLE_PLUGIN_MUTATIONS=true on the agent.

name: get_version
description: Get relayd build metadata and Station runtime version details.

name: create_signed_link
description: Generate a time-bounded signed share URL for a lane that uses access_policy=signed-link.

name: list_companions
description: List managed companion services (databases, caches, etc.) attached to an app lane.

name: restart_companion
description: Restart a named companion service in place.

name: list_variants
description: Read a lane's control release, variants, traffic weights, request/error/latency metrics, and latest 50 feedback entries for 24h, 7d, or 30d. Includes support limitations.

name: set_variant_weight
description: Change a variant's share of new visitors (0-100 percent). Existing visitor assignments remain sticky. All running variant weights must total at most 100; control receives the remainder.

name: promote_variant
description: Queue a deployment of a variant's existing image as the lane's control release. Returns deploy_id; the variant is retired after that deployment succeeds. This is separate from cross-lane promotion approvals.

name: remove_variant
description: Remove a variant's route and containers. Visitors assigned to it fall back to control. Does not remove the lane's control release.

name: reshuffle_variants
description: Reset visitor assignments for a lane under its current variant weights. Every visitor is assigned again on a subsequent request.

name: scale_app
description: Set 1-16 replicas for an existing Docker lane. With apply=true, queues an image redeployment when a running lane needs resizing. With apply=false, saves the size for a later deployment. Returns deploy_id when queued.

name: get_analytics
description: Read lane traffic, errors, latency, bandwidth, and runtime resource data, optionally filtered to one variant (or control). HTTP/HTTPS only; scoped viewer access is required.

name: abort_rollout
description: Abort a canary rollout that is currently monitoring and restore its previous slot. Requires an active standby slot. HTTP/HTTPS only.

name: request_promotion
description: Request promotion of a healthy lane's current image to a different lane. Requires deployer access to both lanes. Production requests by non-owners wait for owner approval when user accounts are enabled.

name: get_runtime_targets
description: List available app, replica, variant, proxy, and companion runtime log targets for a lane, plus the default target and offline state. Use the dashboard Runtime logs page to follow a target's live output.

name: get_admin_ops
description: Read the owner-only operations snapshot: container CPU, memory, storage, lane health, daemon memory, and deployment comparisons.

name: get_status
description: Read the agent's runtime health inventory, including edge and active-slot state, stopped lanes, exit codes, and out-of-memory indicators.

name: list_buildpack_catalog
description: Read the built-in buildpack plugin catalog. Requires owner role.

name: install_buildpack_from_catalog
description: Install a named plugin from the agent's built-in catalog. Requires owner role and plugin mutations enabled on the agent.

name: install_buildpack_from_url
description: Install buildpack plugin JSON from an HTTPS URL, optionally pinned to a SHA256 digest. Requires owner role and plugin mutations enabled. The agent validates and fetches the URL.
